question: Should this PR resolve the heartbeat status issue by relabeling the cadence as config-derived, or should maintainers require the scheduler/default cadence paths to be aligned instead?
rationale: The source shows the current row is config-derived, but the linked issue asks whether status should match observed scheduler delivery; automation cannot choose that product contract.

options.title: Accept label clarification
options.body: Land a cleaned-up version of this PR after proof and conflict cleanup, treating the normal status row as configuration and deep/heartbeat commands as observed runtime checks.

options.title: Require cadence alignment
options.body: Close or replace this PR with a broader fix that makes scheduler/default cadence and status output agree rather than only clarifying the source.
